thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-gpu-serving pool=pool-tungsten region=us-west-2, trigger=CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY on host gpu-46

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGER: high severity - paged @oncall

maya: acked oncall, looking

omar: I'm up, grabbing logs

maya: thanks. early signs: repeated allocator failures from latebind allocator, nvml reports 'out of memory' and kernel reports 'invalid memory access' on a couple nodes.

ivan: seeing kvcache thrash in metrics for model=vicuna-13b-quant, LR=0? also spike in inflight requests

maya: can we confirm customer impact? metrics show degradation for 2 customers: search-api-prod and chat-widget-eu, 5xxs and higher latency

liz: customer 1 (search-api-prod) reported degraded results via support ticket #CS-4821, says "partial responses, truncated". ETA on mitigation?

omar: repro logs attached, tail:
```
[2026-03-15T18:02:12Z] cuda: driver returned 2 (out of memory) while allocating 3.2GiB for tensor
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] allocator: late-binding failed fallback to host; kernel error: invalid device pointer
[2026-03-15T18:02:13Z] runtime: evict attempt failed: kvcache reclaim unable to free required prefix
```

oman: (typo) meant omar

maya: first mitigation: enable cpu-fallback route for high-latency tail and increase kvcache-reclaim aggressiveness on affected pools. issuing command to trigger policy:
```
redwoodctl pool update pool-tungsten --kvcache-reclaim=aggressive --fallback=cpu
```

infra-bot: executed runbook step 1: pool config patch applied to pool-tungsten (jobs will pick up within 30s)

omar: also bumped canary to vicuna-13b-quant-cpu to take overflow traffic

ivan: I'm watching inflight; eviction rate increased, memory pressure dropping on gpu-46 but nvml still shows elevated

maya: paging escalation: if not stabilised in 5m we'll escalate to infra lead @liz

liz: on it, standing by for handoff. start collecting kernel dumps if we hit another OOM.

maya: handoff to next oncall @ivan in 10m for postmortem run, I'll stay on incident channel until stabilised

pagerduty-bot: alert acknowledged by maya (ack id: 82d3). Escalation timer started.

ivan: recording customer impact: search-api-prod (partial responses, 2% requests error), chat-widget-eu (latency 99p increase 600ms), raising incident report and notifying CS-ops

maya: thanks team. followups: 1) dump GPU kernel logs for gpu-46 2) schedule node drain for next maintenance window 3) eval quant config for model variant

omar: note: I see a noisy job from experiments/user-train-112 that allocates huge pinned memory, recommending to terminate if recurs

liz: created support ticket CS-4821 update: "we're investigating, mitigation applied - possible brief interruptions" :thumbsup:

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. If any new OOMs occur, the system will auto-reroute traffic to CPU variant.

maya: closing pager for now. will open a followup thread for postmortem and RCA. Thanks all. :heart:
